ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) across the distal regions of both lobes, estimated at 70% of the visible surface; central region around the median notch exhibits low-intensity (black) pigmentation covering approximately 30%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white zones on the outer halves of both lobes. An irregular black central mass radiates from the median notch, with secondary punctate black spots (mottling) scattered on the white surfaces, notably a distinct circular spot on the upper right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate interior angle of 65 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio relative to the lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge; topography is particularly jagged and discontinuous near the median notch and obscured by biological growth at the lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a complex curve starting with a sharp concave sweep from the median notch, transitioning to a jagged convex trajectory toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, localized clusters of high-intensity (white), circular-to-ovoid pixel groups consistent with barnacle colonization situated on the distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, dark, non-parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the white ventral surface, primarily concentrated on the medial-left lobe and the inner-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and scarring along the trailing edge resulting in a highly serrated profile; extensive barnacle encrustation on the lateral lobe extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: A single, prominent dark circular pigmentation spot isolated in the upper-quadrant of the right fluke lobe.
